about: Change room's rules, stated once for both implementations: TimetableRoomChoice (static/js/timetable-room-choice.js) and split view's roomCodeKey, roomIsOccupied and roomFitsSection (static/js/page-timetable-workspace-split.js). Each room is a candidate as preview_placement_room_candidates sends it; `target` overrides fields of the shared target for that case, `placement` (when present, even null) replaces the shared placement, and `facts` (when present) is the room's factsHtml in English and Arabic. A room that fits (type, gender, seats) can be chosen when it is free or when another section holds it at that time (owner ruling 2026-10-20), and a room that does not fit is a misfit even when it is held; the verdict reads occupied_by only, never the server's tone or `available`, and compares board ids as text. A room that fits, is free and has department_fit false (outside the board's programme rooms) is its own group, a warning worded as Issues word what it saves (Room unsuitable); a room in use keeps its clash's group and tone when it is also outside them, and its words add that. occupied_by is what the server sends: since PR #173 it leaves out the section's own same-slot copies (the ones a room change moves with the meeting); before it, those copies are listed as occupants. Misfit reasons name the type and the gender only: a room short of seats says so in its facts. A case with `audit_target` is an answer asked with ?audit=1 (5c-audit): its target carries `audit`, the shared audit_target with the case's fields over it, and its room the audit's answer (`audit`, as the server sends it; a room without one is judged by the legacy rule). Judged by the audit (target.audit.assessed exactly true and the room carrying `audit`), a room the audit refuses for gender or type (the owner's answer to Q1) is a misfit, with those reasons named from the audit's need; every other room can be chosen: in use (critical on this board, else a warning), flagged (a warning: the meeting's quality reasons after the save, undersized as Room too small and incompatible as Room unsuitable, missing left to the board) or free; its words are Issues' card for it once saved (the lead of its tone, the kinds in Issues' order), then why: the seats the audit needs when Room too small is among them, the programme rooms it is outside (this board's, else the others' by label), a board with no programme, and the room each copy that stays keeps. Its facts measure seats against the audit's need. `fits` and `occupied` stay the legacy rule (split view's answer), so an audit case may fit and be a misfit, or not fit and be chosen: the parity test pins that classic and split differ only on such cases.
